title: Batch 1 verified locally; production build blocked by disk capacity
summary: Shipping truth, retry recovery, stale-response rejection and preserved Production guards passed focused checks. Local review GO; release validation NO-GO until a complete production build succeeds. No deployment or real transactions.

changes.detail: Distinct request identity also rejects reuse across A to B to A; missing quote submit attempts no longer create stale order errors.
37 focused regressions, 24 grouped browser checks, saved synthetic evidence and detailed continuation handoff.
Validation is local only. Existing security/API/price rules and all earlier Change History reports are preserved. Root application edits were not overwritten.

validation.name: Focused regression tests
validation.detail: 37/37, including byte-normalized Production security comparisons, quote races, timeout, retry and pricing regressions.

validation.name: Browser acceptance
validation.detail: 24 grouped checks at 320/390/768/1440 pixels, actual React, mocked APIs only; keyboard retry, disabled checkout, duplicate submissions, idempotency, reload and removal.

validation.name: Candidate TypeScript and lint
validation.detail: No diagnostics from final tsc --noEmit --incremental false or ESLint on four changed application files; git diff --check passed.

validation.name: Learning history regression and types
validation.detail: 6/6 history tests and learning app tsc passed.

validation.name: Production build
validation.detail: Initial Google Fonts network failure; later retry exited during compilation; bounded-memory retry failed ENOSPC. No completed final-source production artifact. Only newly generated candidate .next output/cache removed.

validation.name: External acceptance
validation.detail: No deployment, live backend integration, real order/payment/email/inventory writes, physical-device or screen-reader certification. Saved audit Production identity must be refreshed before release.
